reason_not_in.cursor: It watches Claude Code's tool names for Claude in Chrome.

browser-lock.does: Share Chrome between chats with browser-lock take, wait, release, status and clear.

does: Lets one chat at a time drive Chrome. The others wait for the lock.

children.does: The start of the tool names that drive Chrome.
While a chat holds the lock, Chrome calls from every other chat are refused. A chat's subagents count as that chat.
The refusal tells the chat how to wait for the lock.
A chat may not run browser-lock clear. Only the user clears a lock, from a terminal.
